releaseNotes: Moved debug-report email delivery to the secure Firebase backend so email credentials are no longer included in the APK.
Added server-enforced single-device sessions and automatic sign-out when an account is activated on another device.
Added online, offline, last-seen, and last-login status to the admin user directory.
Improved navigation camera behavior, voice-prompt timing, and maneuver progression near turns.
Improved TxDOT route mileage mapping and placement of official road-change maneuvers on the authoritative GPS route.
